title: Cast & Chord | Music Row Retreat
description: Set the scene in the heart of Music Row. Cast & Chord is a 2BR/2BA in the Crescendo, a purpose-built stay on 16th Ave S—steps from music studios, Vanderbilt, 12 South and the Gulch. Inside: two bedrooms and two full baths—great for two couples or a group—plus a fully stocked kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, and in-unit laundry. Upstairs, the rooftop deck serves panoramic skyline views, a pool with baja ledge, a fitness room, gated garage, and EV charging. Cut a track or soak up Music City. Book today.
